item.title: Home secretary prepares to unveil tougher migrant settlement rules
item.body: Mahmood is preparing to announce tougher settlement rules under which some migrants would wait 10 years or more for the right to settle in the UK. Burnham declined to say whether net migration is still too high.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🏛️ Home secretary prepares to unveil tougher migrant settlement rules

Mahmood is preparing to announce tougher settlement rules under which some migrants would wait 10 years or more for the right to settle in the UK. Burnham declined to say whether net migration is still too high.

Source: Guardian | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 2 November, 09:51
